name: Setup Multi-Instance Work Distribution System
description: Implement work queue and instance registry for distributing activities across independent OpenCode instances with impulse-based data federation

tasks.description: Create instance registry with profile tracking

prompt.template:
Create instance registry system that tracks instance capabilities and resources.

Location: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/coordination/

Files to create:
1. instance-registry.ts - InstanceRegistry class with Redis + SurrealDB storage
2. instance-profile.ts - InstanceProfile interface and types
3. instance-matcher.ts - Smart matching logic for work assignment

InstanceProfile should track:
- instanceId (unique identifier)
- codebases (which repos/paths accessible with read/write access)
- dataLocality (databases, filesets, impulse cache)
- capabilities (languages, tools, services)
- currentLoad (active activities, memory, CPU)
- status (available, busy, draining, offline)
- lastHeartbeat (for health monitoring)

InstanceRegistry operations:
- register(profile): Register instance on startup
- unregister(instanceId): Remove instance
- get(instanceId): Retrieve instance profile
- list(filter?): List all instances with optional filtering
- heartbeat(instanceId): Update last heartbeat timestamp
- updateLoad(instanceId, load): Update current load metrics

Storage:
- Redis hash for fast lookups: instance:{id} -> profile JSON
- Redis sorted set for load balancing: instances:by_load
- SurrealDB for persistent registry

Implement with:
- TypeScript with Zod schemas for validation
- Redis client (ioredis)
- SurrealDB client
- Comprehensive error handling
- Logging with Log.create({ service: "instance-registry" })

Do NOT modify existing vessel registry files. This is a new coordination layer.

tasks.description: Create work queue with claim/complete operations

prompt.template:
Create work queue system for distributing activities across instances.

Location: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/coordination/

Files to create:
1. work-queue.ts - WorkQueue class with Redis-backed priority queue
2. work-item.ts - WorkItem and WorkRequirements types
3. impulse-federation.ts - ImpulseFederation for cross-instance data access

WorkItem structure:
- workId (unique identifier)
- activityTemplateId
- variables (template variables)
- requirements (codebase, data, capabilities, resources)
- sharedImpulses (impulse references for data sharing)
- priority (higher = more urgent)
- createdAt, claimedBy, claimedAt, leaseExpiration

WorkRequirements:
- codebase: { repoPath?, branch?, accessType }
- data: { databases?, impulses? }
- capabilities: { languages?, tools?, services? }
- resources: { minMemory?, estimatedDuration? }

WorkQueue operations:
- push(workItem): Add work to queue with priority
- claim(workId, instanceId, leaseDuration): Atomic claim operation
- complete(workId, result): Mark work complete and publish result
- release(workId, reason): Release work back to queue (for retry)
- extendLease(workId, duration): Extend lease to prevent timeout
- getPending(limit): Get pending work items (sorted by priority)
- reclaimExpired(): Reclaim work with expired leases

Storage:
- Redis sorted set: work:pending (score = priority + timestamp)
- Redis hash: work:claimed (workId -> claim info)
- Redis hash: work:status (workId -> status)
- SurrealDB: work_result:{workId} (persistent results)

ImpulseFederation:
- resolveLocal(impulse): Resolve from local instance
- resolveRemote(impulse, fromInstance): Fetch from remote via ACP
- resolveShared(impulse): Retrieve from SurrealDB
- resolve(impulse, currentInstance, registry): Smart resolution with fallback

Implement with:
- Atomic operations (ZADD, HSET with NX)
- Lease expiration handling
- Priority scoring algorithm
- Comprehensive logging
- Error handling with retries

Create work claimer that instances run to claim and execute work.

Location: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/coordination/

File to create:
- work-claimer.ts - WorkClaimer class with claim loop and execution

WorkClaimer responsibilities:
- Run claim loop continuously
- Check instance capacity before claiming
- Find work that matches instance capabilities
- Claim work atomically
- Execute activity with impulse preparation
- Extend lease via heartbeat
- Handle completion and errors

Key methods:
- claimLoop(instanceId): Main loop that claims and executes work
- findClaimableWork(profile): Find work item instance can handle
- executeWorkAsync(work, profile): Execute activity in background
- prepareImpulses(impulseRefs, profile): Resolve impulses via federation

Integration points:
- Use InstanceRegistry.get() for profile
- Use WorkQueue.getPending() for available work
- Use InstanceMatcher.matchesRequirements() for filtering
- Use WorkQueue.claim() for atomic claiming
- Use ImpulseFederation.resolve() for impulse preparation
- Use executeActivityInline() from tool/activity.ts for execution
- Use WorkQueue.complete() or release() for results

Configuration:
- MAX_CONCURRENT_ACTIVITIES (default: 5)
- LEASE_DURATION (default: 300 seconds)
- CLAIM_LOOP_INTERVAL (default: 2 seconds)

Error handling:
- Graceful degradation if Redis unavailable
- Retry logic for transient failures
- Automatic lease expiration prevents deadlocks
- Failed work released back to queue

Implement with:
- Async/await patterns
- setInterval for heartbeat
- clearInterval on completion
- Comprehensive logging
- Metrics tracking (work claimed, completed, failed)

tasks.description: Integrate with vessel bootstrap and activity tool

prompt.template:
Integrate work distribution system with vessel bootstrap and activity tool.

Changes needed:

1. Update vessel bootstrap (repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/vessel/bootstrap.ts):
   - Import InstanceRegistry and WorkClaimer
   - Register instance on startup with profile:
     * Detect codebases (scan /workspace/repos or similar)
     * Detect capabilities (check for node, python, docker, etc.)
     * Set initial load (0 active activities)
   - Start work claimer loop in background
   - Handle graceful shutdown (unregister instance)

2. Update activity tool (repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/tool/activity.ts):
   - Add option to submit work to queue instead of executing locally
   - Create WorkItem from activity parameters
   - Extract requirements from template metadata
   - Submit to WorkQueue.push()
   - Optionally wait for completion or return immediately

3. Create configuration (repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/coordination/config.ts):
   - Redis connection settings
   - SurrealDB connection settings
   - Work queue configuration (lease duration, max concurrent, etc.)
   - Feature flags (enable_work_queue, enable_impulse_federation)

Example integration:

```typescript
// In bootstrap.ts
import { InstanceRegistry, WorkClaimer } from "./coordination"

const profile = {
  instanceId: VESSEL_ID,
  codebases: detectCodebases(),
  capabilities: detectCapabilities(),
  currentLoad: { activeActivities: 0, memoryUsage: 0, cpuUsage: 0 },
  status: "available"
}

await InstanceRegistry.register(profile)

const claimer = new WorkClaimer()
claimer.claimLoop(VESSEL_ID) // Run in background

process.on("SIGTERM", async () => {
  await InstanceRegistry.unregister(VESSEL_ID)
})
```

```typescript
// In activity tool
if (config.enable_work_queue) {
  // Submit to queue
  const workItem = {
    workId: generateId(),
    activityTemplateId: params.templateId,
    variables: params.variables,
    requirements: extractRequirements(template),
    sharedImpulses: prepareImpulseReferences(impulses)
  }
  
  await WorkQueue.push(workItem)
  
  if (params.wait) {
    return await WorkQueue.waitForCompletion(workItem.workId)
  }
} else {
  // Execute locally (existing behavior)
  return await executeActivityInline(...)
}
```

Implement with:
- Feature flags for gradual rollout
- Backward compatibility (default to local execution)
- Environment variable configuration
- Graceful degradation if coordination unavailable
